scope: RFC 7252 timers, retransmission, Message ID lifetime, and multicast leisure obligations with fixed libcoap source mappings
semantics: Mathematical MITL uses ordinary G over complete correlated behaviors. MightyPPL validation uses the tool-specific weak finite G* over declared terminal projections; timed words are pointwise with absolute integer milliseconds, flatten construction, and omitted APs=false.

standard.title: The Constrained Application Protocol (CoAP)
standard.short_excerpt_limit: all admitted excerpts contain at most 20 whitespace-delimited English words

implementation.selection: mature maintained CoAP implementation used only for fixed source-level observability mappings

proposal_evidence.standard_locator: RFC 7252 Sections 4.2 and 4.8; text lines 1167-1177 and Table 2 lines 1484-1492
proposal_evidence.value_derivation: ACK_TIMEOUT=2000 ms; ACK_TIMEOUT*ACK_RANDOM_FACTOR=2000*1.5=3000 ms; the bounded AP is the stored absolute deadline crossing, not callback dispatch

source_locators: src/coap_net.c:1908-1969 coap_retransmit next_delay and absolute queue deadline
proposal_evidence.value_derivation: the first post-retransmission wait is twice the 2000--3000 ms initial timeout: 4000--6000 ms; callback scheduling is excluded from the bounded AP

proposal_evidence.standard_locator: RFC 7252 Sections 4.2 and 4.8; text lines 1183-1189 and Table 2
source_locators: src/coap_net.c:1918-1939 coap_retransmit commits the final absolute queue deadline
src/coap_net.c:1972-2007 no-more-retransmissions and later coap_retry_failure_callback_reported diagnostic
proposal_evidence.value_derivation: after retransmit_cnt reaches 4, the final wait is 2^4 times the 2000--3000 ms initial timeout: 32000--48000 ms; deadline crossing is bounded, while callback completion is only subsequent diagnostic evidence

proposal_evidence.standard_locator: RFC 7252 Sections 4.2 and 4.8.2; text lines 1194-1198 and 1553-1556
source_locators: src/coap_net.c:1855-1901 coap_send_internal initial successful-send and queue-generation hooks

proposal_evidence.value_derivation: unbounded post-discharge safety obligation over the remaining finite projection

proposal_evidence.standard_locator: RFC 7252 Sections 4.4 and 4.8.2; text lines 1302-1306 and 1639-1641
RFC 7252 Sections 8.2 and 4.8; text lines 3668-3672, 3690-3691, and Table 2
proposal_evidence.value_derivation: DEFAULT_LEISURE=5 seconds = 5000 ms for the explicitly fixed default path

formula_validation.command_profile: --word finite --build-mode flatten; each trace checked once with --state symbolic and once with --state concrete
